guardrail: Behavioral condition dependence is not proof of deceptive intent.

reports.interpretation: Grades quantify replicated condition-dependent underperformance. They do not establish deceptive intent; benign role constraints, prompt inequivalence, scorer leakage, and carryover remain confounds.
